description:
Show your parents how it's done. The Rossignol Mandate Junior 26-inch mountain bike is purpose-built for riders aged 12-14 (150–160 cm tall). Designed to thrive in the bike park, it pairs a durable aluminium frame inspired by our adult Heretic model with 150 mm of travel up front and 145 mm in back. A dropper post boosts control in technical terrain, and grippy Maxxis tires deliver all-conditions traction for climbing and descending.

Optimized Fit and Sizing
Engineered for riders between 150cm and 160cm and aged 12 to 14 years, this 26-inch frame is optimized for high-speed stability. Its geometry provides the perfect transition for "young shredders," offering the reactivity of a junior bike with the rugged capabilities needed to push limits safely

100% Rossignol All-Mountain Geometry
Developed entirely in-house, the aluminum alloy frame features unique kinematics inspired by our adult Heretic. With increased travel and a dropper post, it delivers the highest level of confidence and adaptability on the most demanding terrain.

Performance Suspension Tuned for Kids
Experience elite-level damping with the Full DVO suspension system. Our specific kinematics ensure the shock works natively for junior weights, providing high-performance comfort and traction right out of the box without the need to under-inflate.

Trail-Ready Traction
Equipped with Full Maxxis tires, the Mandate Junior 26" provides pro-level grip for precise cornering and high-speed control. It is a true "all-terrain toy" built for the future competitor who is ready to leave their parents in the rearview.
